text.text_excerpt: STILL 10/10. Went back this week after a weekend of junk. I went around lunch time and there wasn't a line. Maybe I went before lunch? I'm not sure because I was starving. There isn't parking for the building but there is street parking. This is their new location so there is tons of seating and room for a line. I got a pick 4 plate with sweet heat cauliflower bites, cashew mac, green beans, and jambalaya. The mac and jambalaya was pretty sweet but nothing a little hot sauce couldn't fix. The best part is everything is vegan! They even have bread pudding and ice cream! I'm super excited to go back!

I'm so glad to have found a great soul food place in the city that is vegan! Since it's counter service, it is an ideal place for take-out during the pandemic. The staff was professional, friendly, and seemed to be taking necessary precautions (masks properly worn, no noses exposed, etc.). The quantity of food you get for the price is a great value too and should be enough food to have plenty of leftovers for the next day (it heats up pretty dang well). I went on a Monday but was too late for the red beans and rice, so I opted for jamabalaya, cashew mac and cheese, and the sweet potatoes. Every single thing was delicious. Delicious vegan soul food! I loved how friendly the staff was, they greet you when you walk in the door. It really makes you feel welcome- Hey y'all! The food is served cafeteria style. The line to order is a bit tricky, they have a fenced off area along food line...you enter by register and walk to far end. Numerous other guests and I had to be instructed to enter by register...a simple 'Enter here' sign might help? Anywho the food! Lots of choices and while I was surprised by cafeteria style service, it was nice to see all the options. I told them this was my first visit and they walked me through the choices.
